summary:
An exact analytic solution for coherence evolution is derived for a two-qubit superconducting system with $ZZ$-coupling and transverse Josephson tunneling, yielding closed-form time-dependent density matrices and an explicit $C_{
able_1}$ norm expression for all four Bell state initial conditions. Two Bell states are dynamically invariant with constant coherence, while the other two display parameter-dependent oscillations governed by two distinct frequency scales mapping directly to circuit parameters.
motivation: Analytic solutions for coherence dynamics in multi-qubit superconducting systems are scarce, limiting understanding of quantum state evolution and parameter optimization for coherence control in circuit QED platforms.
method: The full time evolution operator was derived exactly without approximations for a two-qubit system with $ZZ$-coupling and transverse Josephson tunneling, with all four Bell states propagated to obtain explicit analytic expressions.
result: Two Bell states exhibit dynamically protected constant coherence while the other two show controlled oscillations with amplitudes and periodicities directly tunable through the $ZZ$-coupling and tunneling parameters, providing analytically tractable tools for parameter optimization.
